articles.title: Stocks drift on Wall Street amid jobs market updates, renewed fighting in US war with Iran
articles.description: Stocks are drifting on Wall Street amid the latest updates on the U.S. jobs market and further escalation in the U.S. war with Iran. The S&P 500 index rose 0.1% Wednesday. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 189 points, or 0.4%. The Nasdaq composite fell 0.1%. Oil prices held steady as the U.S. and Iran intensify attacks against each other. That follows a monthlong lull in the six-month long conflict that has curtailed global oil shipments through the vital Strait of Hormuz. The jobs market is in focus this week. A private monthly report from ADP showed that employment slipped in August.
